header.title: InputNumber
header.description: Numeric field with +/- buttons or arrows, limits, step, precision and Intl.NumberFormat formatting on blur.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Quantity

base.title: Base
base.description: +/- buttons on both sides. The ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys also change the value.

withInfoIcon.title: With info icon
withInfoIcon.description: `infoText` adds an info icon at the top-right.

texts.label: Quantity
texts.helperText: Info control sits at the top-right when infoText is set.

additionButtons.title: Addition buttons
additionButtons.description: `additionButtons` shows stacked chevrons on the right instead of +/-.

minMaxStep.title: Min / max / step
minMaxStep.description: `min` and `max` clamp the value; `step` sets how much it changes and `precision` how many decimals it rounds to.

formatted.title: Formatted
formatted.description: `locale` and `formatOptions` format the value with Intl.NumberFormat on blur.

texts.label: Amount
texts.helperText: Prefix and suffix icons without steppers.

withIconsAndSteppers.title: With icons and steppers
withIconsAndSteppers.description: Icons sit between the +/- buttons and the value.

texts.label: Total
texts.helperText: Icons sit between the +/- controls and the value.

withIconsAndAddition.title: With icons and addition
withIconsAndAddition.description: Prefix icon next to the stacked buttons.

texts.label: Rate
texts.helperText: Prefix icon with chevron addition buttons.

outlineLabel.title: Outline label
outlineLabel.description: `labelPlacement="outline"` places the label on the top border.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the field and the buttons.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

arithmeticIcons.title: Arithmetic icons
arithmeticIcons.description: Icons from @gem-org/gem-system/icons designed for numeric fields.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and pill shape with cn() on wrapperClassName.

css.label: Branded quantity
css.helperText: Tertiary tokens and stacked buttons with their own background.

import.title: Import

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, InputNumber accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size, type, value, defaultValue, onChange and prefix. className goes to the <input> and wrapperClassName to the root container.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.keyboard: ArrowUp and ArrowDown increase and decrease the value by step.
a11y.buttons: Buttons have an aria-label and are out of the tab order; they are disabled at min or max.
a11y.label: helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the input, icons and buttons.
rules.hasSteppers: Applied when the +/- buttons are shown.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: InputNumber has no variables of its own: it uses these gem-system tokens. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-border: Input border and stacked buttons separator.
items.--gem-color-accent: Focus border and focused outline label.
items.--gem-color-bg-subtle: Button hover background and disabled field background.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Placeholder, icons, buttons and helper text.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes except size, type, value, `defaultValue`, `onChange` and prefix.

items.value: Controlled numeric value. Use null for empty.
items.step: Step for the buttons and arrow keys.
items.precision: Decimals used when rounding and formatting (if `formatOptions` does not set maximumFractionDigits).
items.showSteppers: Shows +/- buttons on both sides. Ignored with `additionButtons`.
items.additionButtons: Shows stacked chevrons on the right instead of +/-.
items.formatDisplay: Formats the value on blur with locale and `formatOptions`.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.isDisabled: Disables the field and the buttons.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Receives the parsed number (null when empty or invalid).
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
